evidence.observation: T701 reads 285.6 °C while T702 is 61.9 °C and T712 is 43.8 °C, a pronounced reboiler-to-column temperature discrepancy.
The discrepancy persists: T701 is 291.9 °C, T702 is 76.9 °C, and T712 is 57.9 °C; this flags a thermal or measurement anomaly but does not identify its cause.
Reflux has declined from 0.8 to 0.5 L/h; reported distillate flow has remained 0.0 L/h since t=60 s, while FYI702 is 5.8. Interpretation requires operating-phase and ratio-definition information.

args.missing_evidence: Independent reboiler temperature verification and T701 calibration/location; protocol phase, expected temperature ranges and flow setpoints; FYI702 definition and flow resolution. Pressure instruments are not installed, so pressure-related causes cannot be distinguished from these data. Composition analysis and a separation target are needed to assess separation.
